facts.fact: 教授死讯传来，Perla 第一反应是「麻烦」：发电报给死者兄弟——侄女答「他兄弟也死了」。
facts.anchor: “What a mess,” she muttered, gripping the collar of her robe closed with one hand.

facts.fact: 丧事流程照常营业：请医生签死亡证明、Beto 也得叫（怕被冷落）——她宿醉着操办一切。
facts.anchor: “Go knock on Dr. Carrel’s door and tell him his presence is required.

facts.fact: 杀错人的偶然性揭晓：当晚 Perla 嫌雪莉酒劲薄，喝了私藏龙舌兰——毒酒她一口没碰。
facts.anchor: The previous evening, instead of sherry, which was much too mild when she was in the mood for a proper night of drinking, she had availed herself of one of her secret bottles of tequila.

facts.fact: Carrel 医生抓到浴室里的安眠药+酒，宣布「这是谋杀」并要逮捕无照卖药的药剂师 Facundo Alamilla——真相在桌上没人知道。
facts.anchor: “It’s a murder, and you must make an immediate arrest,” the doctor declared, with such a dramatic intonation that Ulises spilled coffee on his lap and Beto began to cough.

facts.fact: 她对「自杀」的愤怒点：死人居然在房里藏了瓶好酒（还欠她三个月房租）。
facts.anchor: “Vintage wine,” Perla fumed, more outraged at the thought that he had kept an expensive bottle hidden in his room than at the suicide.

facts.fact: 遗书实锤自杀定性：病了几个月、一心求死；怀表和书遗赠 Inés，还有那条不值钱的狗。
facts.anchor: Nepomuceno had written that he’d been unwell for months, that he wished to die, and scrawled a line of poetry after bequeathing his silver-plated pocket watch and his books to Inés.

facts.fact: 与神父砍价：本地墓地从不葬自杀者、要运去 Las Tunas 是敲竹杠——她用「多一公斤肥膘加三比索」的行话砍到本地安葬、无守灵。
facts.anchor: “You can’t be charging me for the man as though he were a chunk of meat at the butcher shop,” Perla said.

facts.fact: 她翻检死者遗物想捞点值钱的，被 Inés 撞见。
facts.anchor: “Seeing if he left anything aside from books and a watch. This is going to cost us a pretty penny.”

facts.fact: 她拒绝给侄女安慰：「接着过日子」；本想拥抱侄女，却被回忆勾起楼梯那天、一阵厌恶攫住她。
facts.anchor: “He was an old drunk and now he’s dead, it’s no surprise. You can’t be falling to pieces.

facts.fact: 全书核心揭晓（现在时闪回末尾）：当年她把要再度离家的 Encarnación 推下楼梯，孩子松开布娃娃、含泪回望——她掐住孩子双臂差点掐死她，最后抱住她哭了。
facts.anchor: She saw me push her, Perla thinks.

facts.fact: 闪回细节：Encarnación 收到墨西哥城戏服工厂的录用电报宣布再度离开；Perla 央求未果，怒极推人——「你们哪都好，就是配不上我」的沉默刺穿她。
facts.anchor: It happens on a day when the fog descends from the mountains.

facts.fact: 案发时年幼 Inés 就站在楼梯边，抱着布娃娃，目睹全程；Perla 逼她「别声张」——她的失语由此而来。
